evidence.packet_hash_provenance: Reviewer copies are as_recorded; only deterministic checker of exact bytes with expected digest conveyed separately upgrades to verified

stop_rules: At first complete evidence receipt stop for review; no merge
If missing access, build dependencies, authorization, or a required scope change: BLOCKED receipt
After initial build failure at most two bounded repair attempts, then BLOCKED
Never self-authorize paid APIs/hosting, worker expansion or architecture substitution

provenance.method: Puppy Linux / Barry Kauler inspiration only, no fork/distribution designation

objective: Disposable first-learning P0a: one pinned, clean-built offline x86-64 QEMU Linux guest with kernel, compressed initramfs, static BusyBox serial shell, three genuine 120s HELLOs, and a second independent boot using unchanged artifacts. Workflow quality is deliverable.

spec.backend: Buildroot 2026.08 candidate only; validate upstream availability/checksum or signature before fetching/building; no silent backend substitution
spec.boot: Direct QEMU kernel/initramfs allowed for P0a; OVMF/UEFI physical boot deferred to P0c
spec.qemu: -nic none, no shared folders, passthrough, host block devices, network or GUI
spec.shell_proof: After boot generate a fresh host token; send shell printf; require a separately emitted exact output line, not a command input echo. Echo-only fixture must FAIL.
spec.heartbeat_origin: uptime_s is integer seconds from guest Linux /proc/uptime (kernel monotonic uptime since boot), NOT elapsed since /init; first HELLO requires absolute uptime_s <=15
spec.artifact_limit: kernel bytes + compressed initramfs bytes strictly below 100000000, not claimed complete ISO size
spec.source_pinning: Record Buildroot/kernel/BusyBox/toolchain/host exact versions, upstream release archive digests, config and commands; bit-identical rebuild not claimed
spec.repeat_boot: Two full boots, SAME kernel and initramfs SHA-256; preserve separate logs/tests; QEMU guest properties same, per-run serial destinations and fresh token may differ
excluded: guest network, GUI, Python, package manager or model runtime

acceptance: Clean pinned source build exits zero with actual kernel and initramfs; write build manifest versions/archive digest/config/build command
Capture exact QEMU argv with -nic none, 128 MiB allocation, no prohibited host shares/devices, and controlled serial streams
Each of two boots reaches shell within <=90 host monotonic seconds, proves newly generated token in separate output line (input command echo never suffices)
For EACH run: 3 actual HELLO records with seq=1,2,3, first /proc/uptime integer <=15, successive guest gaps 115..125, host arrival gaps 105..150, run watchdog 390s
Explicitly NO minimum combined HELLO span >=240s: retired
Second boot uses unchanged identical artifact hashes; record per-run and cross-run comparison
Kernel and compressed initramfs individually measured/hash-verified; sum strictly below 100000000 bytes
Failure fixture checker rejects missing heartbeat, duplicate seq, malformed uptime, incorrect interval, timeout, absent shell output and echo-only response
No runtime network, GUI/Python/model/package dependency; -nic none is not a containment guarantee
Preserve test commands, manifest, build/boot logs, receipt and artifacts outside git as appropriate; never invent test successes
required_outputs: puppy-p0a/README.md including exact host prerequisites, build/boot/test commands
puppy-p0a/ Buildroot config, init, launcher, acceptance checker and negative fixtures
docs/workflow/runs/PUPPF-P0A-002/artifacts.json with SHA256 + byte lengths + retained location
